title: A Republic Services driver stops his route to bring a lost child home
excerpt: When a little one wandered into the street, Alberto Gutierrez stopped the truck and went door to door until he found Mom.
coverAlt: Everyday kindness: stop the truck, bring them home
body:
It was supposed to be an ordinary trash day in a Rowlett neighborhood.

Alberto Gutierrez, a Republic Services driver with more than 30 years on the job, was working his route with a trainee when they spotted a young child alone and upset, running into the street. The child had slipped out a back door at home.

Gutierrez climbed down from the truck, calmed the child and started knocking on doors. At the third house, he found the child's mom.

Afterward, he said he was simply glad he could reunite them – and that the child was safe.

Next time the truck comes down your street, give your driver a wave.
